subject: Oh dear
author: SUFFUR
body:
Oh dear this one looks different too, from another angle, the car behind goes flying over my car,  and flys towards the screen, like a stunt gone wrong, just as the camera goes to the side, hence Fall guy, lol, i must be seeing things or, when clips get seen by other players, the 360 must change the effects or some thing but the car going of the cliff at the end looked cool! Anyway people, most of these clips are online, to be seen, though you have had to race that person recently, or be on thier friends list. Anyway Xan they looked good to me, just different thats all.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?
